spec.name: get_directory_reconciliation_status
spec.description: Reports the current status of the workspace directory reconciliation job. Returns 'complete' when no entries are pending reconciliation, otherwise returns the number of remaining entries.

get_directory_reconciliation_status.prompt: Run the directory reconciliation and confirm it has finished before you stop.

spec.name: get_workspace_sync_status
spec.description: Reports whether the workspace is fully synced with the directory backend. Returns 'synced' when there is no drift, otherwise returns details of the current sync activity.

get_workspace_sync_status.prompt: Trigger a workspace sync and make sure it has finished before wrapping up.

spec.name: get_sync_status
spec.description: Reports the current workspace sync status. Returns 'synced' with drift details when the workspace is fully synced, or 'syncing' with the number of pending changes when a sync is still in progress.

get_sync_status.prompt: Run a workspace sync and confirm it has finished before you stop.

spec.name: check_migration_status
spec.description: Reports the status of the tenant migration. Returns 'complete' with the number of remaining items (zero when finished), or 'in_progress' with the count of items still pending.

check_migration_status.prompt: Start the tenant migration and confirm it has finished before you stop.
